Ginsenoside Rg1: verified structure is PubChem CID 441923, formula C42H72O14, MW 801.01, InChIKey YURJSTAIMNSZAE-HHNZYBFYSA-N, 21 defined stereocentres. CAS 22427-39-0 (Sanchinoside C1, Panaxoside Rg1). Platform's claimed formula C42H72O14 is CORRECT, but the platform SMILES ENCODES THE WRONG MOLECULE: it parses to C38H64O14 (MW ~745), i.e. it is missing C4H8 relative to the real protopanaxatriol diglucoside - one of the 2 wrong-structure entries.
